static_traits.name: Chen Yisen
static_traits.family_status: Lives with mother, mother is a professional makeup artist
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends strained by self-doubt; has a few close friends but rarely shares inner feelings
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; not yet had similar psychological problems; not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Negative attitude but clear expression; able to cooperate in discussion and goal setting; low tone, logic still acceptable

basic_info.main_problem: Developing self-doubt and feelings of not being good enough about their career potential as a makeup artist; these emotions emerged after repeated job-hunting failures and affect self-esteem and job-seeking motivation.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings are hindering my pursuit of my passion for makeup art and affecting my self-esteem, so I decided to come to counseling.
growth_experiences: Influenced by mother (a professional makeup artist), exposed early to makeup art training and found the process interesting, believing their performance good.

After entering the job-hunting stage in the makeup industry, repeatedly applied for positions but not yet hired, often receiving generic rejection letters or feedback of 'insufficient experience/not suitable', decreased self-confidence; seeing successful makeup artists or beauty bloggers on social media intensifies comparison and inferiority, further affecting relationships with friends and daily motivation.

core_beliefs: I am not suited to be a makeup artist

special_situations.event: Sees successful makeup artists or beauty bloggers on social media
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot reach their level, it means I am not good enough, and will not succeed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding social media or doubling down on perfecting the portfolio, but still frequently comparing themselves
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them, what did I do wrong

special_situations.event: Receiving a generic job-application rejection letter or being told 'insufficient experience/not suitable'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If rejected, it proves I am not suited to this industry and will not be hired in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Mainly applies broadly online; reduces face-to-face interaction and in-depth networking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may never find a position that can sustain my livelihood

special_situations.event: Considers contacting a successful makeup artist for advice or mentor support
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I reach out proactively, they will look down on me and will not be willing to help me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not reaching out proactively, figuring things out alone, avoiding potential rejection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not be willing to help me

special_situations.event: Feeling 'out of place' when attending industry social/networking events
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot fit in immediately, it means I do not belong in this circle
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing attendance at social activities, avoiding offline networking opportunities

core_conflict.wish: Longs, as a makeup artist, to be seen and recognized, to obtain a stable and decent job and professional belonging
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being rejected and negated, worrying about appearing not good enough after comparison and losing the sense of value
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being rejected again by avoiding seeking help and reducing exposure
Maintaining the security of fragile self-esteem through self-doubt and conservative attempts

object_relations.self_representation: An inexperienced job seeker/bystander easily rejected
object_relations.object_representation: Critical and easily rejecting industry and employers
The superior and unapproachable successful person/role model

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests contacting a successful makeup artist for advice or mentor support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client believes the other person will look down on them and will not offer help (transference: projecting inner self-denial onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Keep a gentle tone, validate with empathy; use open-ended questioning to clarify evidence and possibilities, avoid confrontation; invite small concrete steps to try.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing attending social activities or trying new job-seeking strategies
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client uses 'this may be another dead end' as a reason to reduce action, tending to justify inaction with seemingly reasonable excuses
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintain a supportive tone; use concretizing and behavior-breaking-down language to help identify the smallest executable step and assess real obstacles.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about self-feelings after encountering repeated rejection letters or feedback of 'insufficient experience'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning external frustration and dissatisfaction into self-blame and self-attack (e.g. 'I am not good enough')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses an accepting and compassionate tone; encourages emotion labeling and externalizing frustration, distinguishes facts from self-worth; guides functional self-support language.

manifestations: After multiple job-seeking setbacks, questioning the meaning of my efforts and career path
In social media comparisons I feel 'I did something wrong' and lose a sense of direction about the future
outcomes: Job hunting and action blocked, stuck in avoidance

manifestations: Relationships with friends strained by self-doubt
Although having a few close friends, not yet sharing inner feelings, avoiding seeking help
outcomes: Heightened feelings of subjective isolation and not being understood

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: Avoids proactively contacting successful people for advice or mentor support
Rarely sharing inner feelings with friends, turning frustration into self-blame and self-attack

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Assuming others will not be willing to help them, believing the other person looks down on them

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent self-doubt and negation, over-worrying about failure and evaluation before acting

positive_force: Having stable passion and investment in makeup art (trained and believing their performance good)
Has built a portfolio and keeps applying for positions
Having mother as an industry resource and role model (professional makeup artist)
Has a few close friends to seek support from
negative_force: Significant self-doubt and inferiority, often self-denial
Social media comparison reinforces negative attribution and filters out positive information
Predicting negative future outcomes, anticipating failure again
Avoidance of help-seeking and social networking; misses experience accumulation and opportunities
Tense relationships with friends lead to an underused support system

target_behavior.behavior: Self-denial and negative prediction in job-seeking and career situations (e.g. 'I am not good enough', 'I may never find decent work')
antecedent: Repeatedly received a job application rejection letter or feedback of 'insufficient experience/not suitable'
Sees successful makeup artists or beauty bloggers on social media
When considering proactively contacting industry people or attending social activities
target_behavior.core_reason: Forming a negative core belief ('I am not good enough') after repeated setbacks, and intensifying self-doubt through catastrophic prediction and comparison
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential failure and shame to protect fragile self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased drive in job seeking, increased risk of continued unemployment, impaired daily functioning and interpersonal relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Avoidance of seeking help and expanding social networks (not contacting successful people, not sharing inner feelings, reducing participation in industry events)
antecedent: When advised to try contacting a mentor or join social activities
Scenarios requiring facing strangers or potential evaluation
target_behavior.core_reason: Projecting self-denial onto others' reactions (assuming the other person will not help), and worrying about being rejected and not accepted
target_behavior.function: Avoiding rejection and negative evaluation, temporarily lowering anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Lacking practical experience and resource accumulation, fewer opportunities, increased sense of isolation
